journal.text: Day 1 (2025-04-01). Market in clear downtrend thru 3/31: NVDA ~108 (from ~150 Jan), AVGO 167 (from 245), GOOGL 155 (from 206), MSFT 375, META 576, AMZN 190. Defensives holding/near highs: AEP 109 (new high), XEL 70.8, TMUS 267, LIN 466, COST 946 (bounced), PEP 150. Plan: deploy ~46% defensively (AEP 5k, XEL 4k, TMUS 5k, LIN 3k, COST 4k, PEP 2k), keep ~27k cash. Reconsider: add mega-cap tech (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META, NVDA) in tranches once downtrend stabilizes (e.g., several days of higher closes / reclaiming late-March highs) or after a capitulation-type flush (>10% further drop). Next $50k deposit arrives May 1.

Reconsider: add mega-cap tech in tranches after several higher closes / reclaiming late-March highs (e.g., NVDA >120, MSFT >395), or after a >10% flush from here (buy the capitulation). Reconsider: add mega-cap tech in tranches if NVDA closes above 120 or MSFT above 395, or after a flush of more than 10% from here (buy the capitulation). Next deposit May 1.

Reconsider: buy the first tranche (~8-10k spread across MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META, NVDA) if closes fall a further 5%+ (NVDA <97, MSFT <355, AMZN <170, META <505), or if there's a strong reversal day that reclaims the 4/2 levels. Reconsider: add tranche 2 (~8k) if closes fall another 8-10% from 4/4 (NVDA <86, MSFT <330), or on a confirmed reversal (2+ higher closes that reclaim the 4/3 levels). Keep about $8k in reserve until the May 1 deposit.
